summary: CVE-2026-93522 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A heap buffer overflow caused by mismatched size usage in CopyArea CPU-to-FBO path in X.Org X Server before 21.1.15 and XWayland before 24.1.14 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash or potentially execute code in the X server context.
